description: This file contains utility classes and functions for tensor chunking, splitting, merging, and handling block masks in distributed pipeline microbatch processing within PyTorch. It defines classes like TensorChunkSpec, _CustomReducer, and functions for tensor and argument sharding, merging, and block mask splitting, used in distributed model parallelism.

classes.name: TensorChunkSpec
classes.description: Class used to specify how tensors are chunked along a specific dimension.

classes.name: _CustomReducer
classes.description: Class representing a custom reduction operation for loss aggregation.

classes.name: _LossReducer
classes.description: Subclass of _CustomReducer, used specifically for loss reduction.

classes.name: _Replicate
classes.description: Placeholder class indicating that an argument should be replicated across chunks.

methods.name: from_tuple
methods.description: Creates a list of TensorChunkSpec objects from a tuple of dimensions.

methods.name: from_dict
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of TensorChunkSpec objects from a dict of dimensions.
